Seems like the splits are not happening as expected in this test, a lot of similar failures according to [report]( https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/search?error_details=active+tablets%2C  )

```
Log: https://jenkins.dev.yugabyte.com/job/github-yugabyte-db-centos-master-clang15-debug/965/artifact/build/debug-clang15-dynamic-ninja/yb-test-logs/tests-integration-tests__cql-tablet-split-test/CqlTabletSplitTest_BatchTimeseries.log

../../src/yb/integration-tests/cql-tablet-split-test.cc:700
Failed
Bad status: Timed out (yb/integration-tests/cql-tablet-split-test.cc:132): Timed out waiting for 7 active tablets, only got 4
```
@arybochkin , Can we increase the reliability of these tests by increasing the data loaded in them, similar to the other test reliability fixes you made.
@arybochkin , Can we pick this up in the upcoming weeks?
One of TSs was hanged forever for failing runs. It happens somewhere after the first split was applied by all peers. Will collect more logs and cores to understand why it is hanging.

Looks like it was not hanged but crashed at some point
